# turn-notify

> Native Windows answer previews and notification sound for Claude Code. MIT licensed. Marketplace: claude-turn-notify. Plugin: turn-notify.

Repository: https://github.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify
Agent instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/main/AGENTS.md
Install guide: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/main/docs/INSTALL.md
English overview: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/main/docs/README.en.md
Marketplace: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
Plugin: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/main/plugins/turn-notify/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
Latest release: https://github.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/releases/latest
License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify/main/LICENSE

Requires native Windows 10/11, Windows PowerShell 5.1, plugin-capable Claude Code CLI and interactive desktop. Unsupported: WSL, macOS, Linux, headless sessions.
Install: claude plugin marketplace add Gongkddz/claude-turn-notify
Then: claude plugin install turn-notify@claude-turn-notify --scope user
Verify: claude plugin list --json
Open a NEW session; run /turn-notify:status and /turn-notify:test.
Commands: /turn-notify:on, /turn-notify:off, /turn-notify:status, /turn-notify:test, /turn-notify:help.
The hook makes no network requests. Previews may persist in local pending files and Windows history. Registration is distinct from visible desktop delivery.
